description: Frozen batch of 20 independently reviewed and registered idiom illustrations, catalog 690 to 710. Prior backup content retained.

prompt.style_prompt: Original landscape 3:2 picture-book illustration; delicate graphite pencil linework, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture on warm ivory paper, muted natural colors, no 3D. No text, signs, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
prompt.scene_prompt: Meaning: fickle loyalties, repeatedly changing sides to suit oneself (negative). Modern school club election scene: one student in the center turns toward two rival club groups, secretly switching a plain colored team ribbon from one wrist to the other while smiling ingratiatingly at whichever group currently offers a prize. The two groups look disappointed and distrustful as they notice the repeated disloyalty. Show a single clear moment, only three or four students, no duplicated figures, no split panels. Make the self-serving change of allegiance visible, not normal exploration or friendly cooperation. Natural anatomy, hands and ribbon contact, grounded feet, coherent school courtyard.

entries.alt: 學生偷偷更換手腕上的隊伍色帶，兩邊社團同學發現後都露出失望神情。

prompt.style_prompt: Original landscape 3:2 picture-book illustration, delicate graphite pencil lines, soft translucent watercolor, colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, muted natural colors, no 3D or gloss, no text/letters/numbers/logo/watermark.
prompt.scene_prompt: Meaning: craftsmanship so ingenious and refined it seems beyond ordinary human skill. Modern scene: an artisan carefully carving a beautiful flowing sculpture from a single piece of wood in a bright community workshop; the finished carving has delicate leaves and waves, with precise tool marks and curled shavings, while a child watches in awe. Emphasize skillful human workmanship, not supernatural beings or magic. One artisan and one child; natural hands holding a small safe carving tool, correct contact between tool and wood, stable workbench and clamped wood, no dangerous action.

entries.alt: 木雕師傅在工作桌前細心雕刻，孩子欣賞完成的精巧作品。

prompt.scene_prompt: Modern community flood rescue. A trained adult rescue volunteer in proper life vest and helmet stands securely on a rescue boat, extending a rope toward a stranded family on a stable raised platform while another rescuer supports them. Show courage and selfless duty with safe teamwork, no injury or death. Natural anatomy, plausible rope grips, boat and waterline.

entries.alt: 救援人員穿戴安全裝備，在同伴支援下從救援艇伸出繩索協助受困家庭。

prompt.style_prompt: Children's picture book, landscape 3:2, graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural grass green, pale sky blue and earthy brown; no text, logos or watermarks.
prompt.scene_prompt: Contemporary community courtyard. A warm, socially skilled adult organizer introduces a gardener carrying seedlings to a teacher holding a blank community garden model while another neighbor joins with a watering can. Their eye contact, open gestures and emerging cooperative garden plan convey an ability to connect people and opportunities rather than literal long-sleeve dancing. Exactly four adults; natural limbs, grips and ground contact.

prompt.scene_prompt: A once-grand forest tree has already fallen safely in a quiet clearing, roots and broad trunk visible. Four small macaques that formerly gathered in its branches scatter away in different directions, looking back at the lost gathering place. The fallen tree and dispersal clearly express the idiom's patron-falls/dependents-scatter relationship. No monkey under the trunk, no falling motion or injury. Natural limbs, tails and ground contact.
